item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-3c076fb29c4e1147","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In 2023, 329,120 first asylum applications were filed in Germany, a 51.1% increase from 2022; 306,517 applications were cross-border, with Syria, Türkiye, and Afghanistan the main countries of origin.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the report was published in 2025.","ruler_attribution":"The report describes national migration outcomes and policies during Scholz's chancellorship but does not attribute the figures solely to Scholz.","limitations":["The figures are descriptive and do not establish causal responsibility or policy effectiveness."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3c076fb29c4e1147","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Germany enacted a further amendment to skilled-immigration law in 2023, entering into force in stages from November, while 72,400 third-country nationals entered with residence permits for employment, a 0.9% decline from 2022.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.6","5B.10","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report identifies the federal legal amendment under Scholz's government but does not isolate his personal role.","limitations":["The report does not provide implementation quality, fiscal cost, or longer-term labor-market outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3c076fb29c4e1147","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In 2023, 58,775 third-country nationals received education-related residence permits after entering Germany; vocational-training migration increased 27.0% to 10,220 people, while study migration fell 9.5% to 40,435.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.10","6B.2","6B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report records national outcomes during Scholz's term without attributing them solely to his decisions.","limitations":["The figures do not show service quality, completion, distributional effects, or causal effects of federal policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5c381594ab15249a","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"At the November 2023 Bundeswehr conference, Scholz committed the government to meeting NATO's 2% of GDP defense-spending target from 2024 onward and throughout the 2020s and 2030s; he linked the commitment to the war in Ukraine and threats to Europe's security order.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Olaf Scholz, as Chancellor, made the commitment and framed its security rationale.","limitations":["The source reports a commitment and rationale, not complete later execution or proportionality assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5c381594ab15249a","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz said the €100 billion Bundeswehr special fund was a first step, that two-thirds would be contractually committed by the end of 2023, and that more than €20 billion in additional annual defense spending would be needed to meet the 2% target long term.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The quantitative claims and spending direction were presented by Scholz's government.","limitations":["The report does not independently verify all projections or assess procurement value for money."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5c381594ab15249a","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz rejected restoring compulsory military service despite personnel gaps, preferring more intensive use of reservists; the Bundeswehr had about 181,000 personnel against a 2027 target of at least 203,000.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within November 2023, with the personnel target inherited from 2020.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz explicitly rejected a return to conscription and endorsed reservist use.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether the reservist approach met staffing or readiness objectives."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5c381594ab15249","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz acknowledged that bureaucratic and organizational obstacles had slowed the Bundeswehr and that equipment deficiencies had been criticized, including by the Parliamentary Commissioner for the Armed Forces.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.3","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly reported in November 2023; some cited deficiencies predate 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz publicly acknowledged the institutional shortcomings while in office.","limitations":["The article does not identify specific corrective measures or assign responsibility for each deficiency."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5c381594ab15249","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz highlighted Germany's European Sky Shield Initiative, which had attracted 19 NATO members, and continued support for Franco-German-Spanish FCAS and Franco-German MGCS defense projects.","question_ids":["2B.8","2B.10","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within November 2023, with projects extending beyond the period.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz presented these multinational defense initiatives as part of Germany's security policy.","limitations":["The source does not measure operational effectiveness, cost, or completion."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2585ed06e0cd7793","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"An independent KviAPol project surveyed more than 3,300 people affected by police violence and conducted more than 60 interviews; the sample was not representative and focused on conduct perceived by participants as exceeding acceptable limits.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Published and reported in May 2023; research concerns policing more broadly.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns German policing institutions under the federal system and is not attributed personally to Scholz.","limitations":["The sample was explicitly non-representative; the study's perception measure does not itself establish illegality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2585ed06e0cd7793","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The study reported 2,790 investigations into police officers for unlawful use of force in 2021; more than 90% were discontinued and prosecutors brought charges in only 2% of cases, while only 14% of surveyed respondents said a criminal proceeding occurred in their case.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","3B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reported in 2023 but the administrative figures concern 2021.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns German police accountability systems and is not attributed solely to Scholz.","limitations":["The statistics predate 2023 and the source does not identify federal measures taken during the target year."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2585ed06e0cd7793","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Among surveyed people reporting excessive police violence, 55% had encountered police at demonstrations or political actions and 25% at football matches or other major events; 72% were men.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.8","3B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reported in May 2023; survey evidence concerns prior experiences.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns German policing practices and does not establish personal direction by Scholz.","limitations":["The sample was non-representative and the article does not provide a 2023 trend or federal attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-576afd4b101576f5","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In April 2023, a video showed a Berlin police officer applying a pain grip to a seated, peaceful climate protester; Berlin police said the incident was being investigated and that a criminal complaint for bodily harm in office had been filed.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","3B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within April 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The incident involved Berlin police; the article reports national Interior Minister Nancy Faeser's support for a strong police response but does not attribute operational control to Scholz.","limitations":["The source does not report the final legal or disciplinary outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-576afd4b101576f5","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Police-union leader Rainer Wendt called for Berlin to extend preventive detention for climate activists from 48 hours to 30 days, while experts cited legal duties to exhaust peaceful conflict-resolution methods before using force.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","3B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within April 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These were proposals and legal assessments by police and experts, not a recorded decision by Scholz.","limitations":["The source does not show that the proposed extension was enacted or endorsed by Scholz."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3ef8c24fedd169d7","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In May 2023, German authorities searched 15 properties in seven states linked to Last Generation activists, deployed about 170 officers, seized two bank accounts and other assets, and shut down the group's website on prosecutorial instructions; seven suspects were accused of forming or supporting a criminal organization and collecting at least €1.4 million.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within May 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The operation was conducted by Bavarian police and prosecutors within Germany's federal system; the source does not attribute the operational decision to Scholz.","limitations":["The source does not report final judicial findings or whether Scholz approved the operation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3ef8c24fedd169d7","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Scholz described climate activists' practice of sticking themselves to paintings or roads as 'completely crazy'; Interior Minister Faeser said legitimate protest ends where crimes are committed or others' rights are infringed.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within May 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was made by Chancellor Olaf Scholz; Faeser's separate statement was made as Federal Interior Minister.","limitations":["The source does not show that Scholz ordered unlawful restrictions or incited violence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64d3a4b7e3413bde","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The BKA reported that organized-crime groups in Germany continued to have high violence and intimidation potential, including threats against police, justice officials, lawyers, witnesses, family members, and rival groups.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within the 2023 reporting year.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns Germany's security environment and law-enforcement challenge, not personal conduct by Scholz.","limitations":["It does not measure Scholz's specific policy contribution or distinguish federal from state responsibility."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64d3a4b7e3413bde","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In roughly one quarter of organized-crime investigations in 2023, analysis of encrypted telecommunications produced substantial investigative results; the BKA identified encrypted communications as a central investigative challenge.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.6","3B.9","4B.9","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns BKA and police investigative capacity; the source does not attribute the result personally to Scholz.","limitations":["The statistic does not establish whether surveillance safeguards were adequate or whether outcomes improved because of Scholz's decisions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64d3a4b7e3413bde","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The BKA recorded 642 organized-crime investigations in 2023, 7,347 suspects, and €2.7 billion in economic damage, twice the previous year's amount and the highest damage total in the preceding decade.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.10","5B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within the 2023 reporting year.","ruler_attribution":"The figures describe Germany's organized-crime situation and do not establish personal responsibility by Scholz.","limitations":["The damage increase may reflect reporting, case composition, or external factors; the source does not provide a causal policy evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64d3a4b7e3413bde","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The BKA reported that about 70% of organized-crime investigations had international connections and described strengthened cooperation with Europol and European and Latin American partners, including a joint port-security center established in Hamburg in 2023.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.10","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The cooperation involved German law-enforcement institutions under the federal government, but the source does not attribute the center personally to Scholz.","limitations":["The source does not quantify the center's effects on crime or asset recovery."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-45780fd0d7671ab7","SRC-dcf9d76e7cf8acdb","SRC-c076799b024def08","SRC-460116f4e3954b76","SRC-c120a92033914264","SRC-33cdb6fbe858a0c2"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents concern periods outside 2023 or contain unrelated current-page material; they were treated as having no material fact for the defined 2023-2023 period.","The supplied documents generally report national or institutional developments and often do not establish Olaf Scholz's personal causal responsibility.","No facts were used to score any chapter or question."]}
